pr.title: Refine BaseTab helpers for profile binding
pr.body:
### Description

This PR follows up on the merged `BaseTab` refactor by adding a small set of helper
improvements suggested during review.

Changes included in this PR:

- added `call_now=True` support to `BaseTab` tracking helpers so tabs/pages can
  subscribe to app signals and perform the initial update through the same path
- added `bind_profile_attr()` and `bind_repo_attr()` helpers to reduce repeated
  widget-to-model lambda glue
- updated affected views to use the new helpers:
  - `schedule_page.py`
  - `shell_commands_page.py`
  - `networks_page.py`
- simplified repeated `populate_from_profile(); track_profile_change(...)` patterns
  in a few tabs/pages where the new `call_now` support fits cleanly
- added unit tests for the new `BaseTab` helper behavior

This is a small follow up cleanup slice and does not change the overall architecture
introduced in the earlier `BaseTab` work.

### Related Issue

Part of #2361

### Motivation and Context

After the initial `BaseTab` refactor, a few repetitive patterns were still present in
the views layer:

- several tabs/pages repeated an initial `populate_from_profile()` call followed by
  `track_profile_change(...)`
- widget-to-model persistence wiring still used repeated lambdas for simple profile
  and repo attribute updates

This PR trims those remaining patterns by extending `BaseTab` with small helper
methods that keep the views layer more consistent and easier to maintain.

### How Has This Been Tested?

Test environment:
- Windows
- `uv` project environment
- existing PyQt6 test setup from the repository

Passed:
- `uv run pre-commit run --files src/vorta/views/base_tab.py src/vorta/views/schedule_page.py src/vorta/views/shell_commands_page.py src/vorta/views/networks_page.py src/vorta/views/repo_tab.py src/vorta/views/source_tab.py src/vorta/views/archive_tab.py tests/unit/test_base_tab.py`
- `uv run py -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_base_tab.py -q`
- `uv run py -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_base_tab.py tests/unit/test_schedule.py tests/unit/test_misc.py tests/unit/test_repo.py -k "repo_unlink_shared_repository_keeps_dropdown_entry or test_base_tab or test_schedule_tab"`

Notes:
- the focused tests for the new helper behavior passed
- broader `tests/unit/test_repo.py` still has pre-existing Windows/environment-sensitive failures outside the scope of this refactor slice

### Screenshots (if appropriate):

Not applicable.

### Types of changes

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

### Checklist:

- [x] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING](https://vorta.borgbase.com/contributing/) guide.
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] My change requires a change to the documentation.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [x] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed.

*I provide my contribution under the terms of the [license](./../LICENSE.txt) of this repository and I affirm the [Developer Certificate of Origin][dco].*

[dco]: https://developercertificate.org/
